run_generate_arabic: run the python script to generate Arabic text from English prefixes using grammar-constrained GPT-2
create_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar file for Arabic text generation
build_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to enforce grammar rules during model generation
